definition: The pattern from monochromatic light through one narrow slit of width $b$: a bright central maximum, twice as wide as the much dimmer maxima beside it, with the first minimum at an angle $\theta = \frac{\lambda}{b}$ in radians.
A plate with a large number of equally spaced parallel slits, a distance $d$ apart, giving sharp bright maxima at the angles where $n\lambda = d\sin\theta$.
